label: AI agent launch
text: We just shipped our first AI agent into production. The demo worked, but retries, permissions and failure recovery turned out to be the real work.

label: Hackathon win
text: We just won the business track at a student hackathon in Tallinn. Built an AI management tool in 48 hours. The product was fun, but meeting other builders was easily the best part.

label: Personal milestone
text: One month into university. New people, one failed exam and somehow way too much money spent on coffee. Wouldn't trade it for anything.

label: Product launch
text: After six months of building, breaking and rebuilding, our developer tool is finally live. The funny part is how much of the work happened after the demo already worked.

label: Unrelated / skip
text: Spent the weekend hiking with friends. Perfect weather and a very good sandwich.

label: Agent autonomy
text: We're giving our agents more tools and more autonomy. The unresolved question is when an irreversible action should require human approval.

label: AI evaluation
text: Our evaluation pipeline catches obvious agent failures well, but we're still struggling with outputs that are technically correct and not useful to the user.

label: Document parsing
text: Our document parser improved its average benchmark score by 12%, but scanned pages, tables, forms and charts are still failing very differently.

label: Agent memory
text: We improved an agent's memory by deleting more context instead of storing more of it. More information turned out not to mean better memory.

label: Unrelated / skip
text: Spent the weekend hiking with friends. The weather was perfect.
